completed: Document original authority excludes the broad approved-summary relationship baseline while preserving ownership/self identity, accepted collaborations, editing relationships and explicit individual full-file grants. Global student access helpers are unchanged.
Two restrictive child-row policies bind actual document/student identity and protect raw extraction and legacy summary rows.

Authenticated-only fixed-path stable definer returns only eight allowlisted accepted/edited section values from current in-review/complete records. It excludes raw text, originals, notes, private section keys, pending/rejected/malformed/oversize values and blocked/rejected/archived/deleted sources.

Projection list returns at most50 recent eligible document identities/revisions/readiness flags with no section values. Read requires loaded actor/student/document/review revisions; changed versions return no row.
Existing summary APIs use caller RPC only, never service fallback or raw table reads. Strict receipts and generic errors prevent private diagnostic leaks.

Shared card is account/student keyed, ignores departed replies, handles unavailable reads distinctly and refreshes explicitly. It is now connected to the existing read-only student Documents tab with team-friendly wording, not added below dashboard widgets.
Read-only banners/empty-file wording do not promise original downloads or infer no documents were uploaded. Access and download-link audit wording reflect their actual scope.
remaining: Permanent individual-grant retirement after recipient/grantor access removal and re-addition is not implemented here.
Legacy document visibility labels/private-family scopes and the rights-transfer writer remain open.
can_access_student is intentionally unchanged for profiles/reports/other tools; this is the document/original/raw-row boundary, not a whole-platform summary-permission certification.
The projection is a structural reviewed-section allowlist, not a clinical redaction or policy/legal-approval certificate.
Old copied/displayed data, existing bearer URLs, provider cessation and actual Storage/API behavior remain separate gates.
PostgREST RPC registration, exact hosted all-role/mobile/navigation acceptance and demo/live feature-claim review are pending. No new public-demo private-data query or role switch was added.
Canonical promotion/SECURITY DEFINER inventory and ledger/order/preflight/authorized hosted rollout remain separate.
